title: dischidia nummularia var. orbicularis
intro: Dischidia nummularia var. orbicularis, commonly known as the Money Plant or Variegated String of Nickels, is a type of flowering epiphyte native to the tropical regions of Australia and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its air-purifying properties and is often used in indoor spaces to promote a healthier environment. The health benefits of Dischidia nummularia var. orbicularis include reducing stress and anxiety, improving air quality, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
